remark: The exceptions are not avoided because: (1) IllegalAccessException can be thrown if the class or its nullary constructor is not accessible due to access modifiers or class loader restrictions. (2) InstantiationException can be thrown if the class is abstract, an interface, an array, primitive, void, lacks a nullary constructor, or instantiation fails. (3) ExceptionInInitializerError can be thrown if the class's static initializer fails. (4) SecurityException can be thrown if a security manager denies package access. The code does not validate the class type, accessibility, or security context before calling newInstance(), so these conditions are not prevented.
